artworks.title: Roman Landscape
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an elevated view, showcasing the terrain with rolling hills, mountains in the distance, and a town with buildings and a church tower in the far horizon. A pair of figures is seated beneath trees close to the viewer. The artistic style features intricate etching with detailed linear patterns, creating texture and depth. The trees are depicted with expressive lines, and the color scheme is monochromatic in black and white. The artwork conveys a serene and pastoral atmosphere.

artworks.title: Roman Landscape
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape from a low vantage point. A group of people are near a calm body of water, engaged in activities such as fishing or resting. In the background are distant hills or low mountains. A stone bridge crosses over the water. The artwork features fine and detailed brushstrokes or etched lines in a monochrome etching technique with cross-hatching and line work. The color palette is mainly sepia and black. Tall, slender trees flank the scene, their foliage depicted with delicate lines. The sky above contains softly rendered clouds.

artworks.title: Roman Landscape
artworks.description: The image depicts a riverbank scene with a person in a small boat on the water. The river curves, leading to a stone bridge in the distance. Tall trees frame the scene with detailed brushwork. The artwork uses a monochromatic color palette and shows rolling hills under a sky with light clouds.

artworks.title: Ruined Abbey
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a ruined building on the left side, a figure with a staff near the ruins, and a group of figures and animals passing through a stone gateway in the distance. The sky dominates the top half of the composition, with trees scattered throughout the scene. The color palette consists mostly of sepia tones.

artworks.title: Ruined Abbey with Cattle and a Man Chopping Wood
artworks.description: The image features architectural ruins in a landscape. The scene includes a partially crumbled structure with arched windows and towers. In the background, there is a horizon with distant land and a water body, possibly depicting a small town or village. The foreground shows a figure tending to goats, with a few more figures walking along a path towards the ruins. A tree is visible on the left side of the composition. The artwork is done in a style with precise, linear brushstrokes and hatching techniques, creating a textured effect. The color palette is monochromatic, using sepia tones.

artworks.title: Ruins with a Seated Man, and a Covered Wagon in the Distance
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient ruin with a prominent archway, viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The sky occupies the upper third of the image, with the horizon line at the top of the ruins. The ruins are depicted with intricate brushstrokes, emphasizing the stone texture and overgrown vegetation. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown to create depth and shadow. Surrounding the ruins are details of small trees and grass, extending into the distance where a group of people and an ox cart can be seen on a path. The background includes trees and distant landscape features.

artworks.title: Ruined Abbey with Travelers on the Road
artworks.description: The image contains a landscape with ruins seen from a slightly elevated position. The horizon is high up in the composition, showcasing distant hills without structures. Ruins dominate the right side with detailed stonework and arches, surrounded by a few remaining trees. A person on horseback and another walking are on a nearby road. The sky has soft clouds and a flock of birds. The color palette is monochromatic, with shadows and light giving texture through line work, characteristic of an etching's hatching technique.

artworks.title: Ruins by a River with a Man in a Boat
artworks.description: The image shows a point of view from slightly below, capturing a large, dilapidated stone structure on a cliff. The horizon is low with water running along it. The structure appears to be a ruin with an arched section and vertical walls. The sky has wispy clouds. The depiction uses fine lines and hatching for texture. The scene is monochrome, with shades of brown and beige. Near us are rocks and trees, and in the distance, a boat with two figures. Farther away, faint outlines of another building are visible across the water.

artworks.title: Ruins with Two Women Washing Clothes in a River
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a building in ruins at the center. The horizon is in the middle, aligned with distant treetops. The structure has tall, arched windows, distinctive against the sky with soft clouds. The technique includes etching lines for texture and depth, especially for trees and grass. Two figures are near the water. The palette is sepia-toned, giving a warm, nostalgic feel and highlighting the antiquity of the ruins.

artworks.title: The Hinny Drover, via Appia
artworks.description: The image features a rural landscape with a low horizon, water meeting land, figures with animals on the shoreline, a person walking beside pack animals, rustic buildings emitting smoke, and a monochrome color scheme of sepia tones.

artworks.title: Capriccio with Edinburgh Castle and Arthur's Seat
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape viewed from an elevated point. A large tree with long branches is present on the left side. In the distance, there are hills, mountains, and an architectural structure resembling a castle or large house. The artwork appears to be an etching with detailed lines depicting texture on the terrain and sky. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown, creating a vintage effect. The attention to textures in the water and landscape contribute to the overall atmosphere. Cattle are visible on the right side in a calm body of water.

artworks.title: Mountainous Landscape with a Waterfall, Round Tower, Castle, and Banditti
artworks.description: The image features a landscape scene with a view from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is defined by a mountain range dominating the upper middle portion of the composition. Linear clouds in the sky above the mountains suggest a woodcut technique. Closest to us, a dense grouping of trees frames the left side, depicted with intricate detail. A waterfall cascades down a rocky slope, its flowing water captured with curved lines. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of sepia, creating depth and texture. Additional hills in the distance rise gently, adorned with clusters of trees and a hint of human presence.

artworks.title: Brutto Buono Stoned by His Enemies
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with multiple figures in action. The composition is filled with characters engaged in various activities. The background includes trees and buildings, providing context to the scene. A small dog is depicted in the foreground. The textures and lines convey a sense of movement. The overall tone is classical with a focus on detail and expression.

artworks.title: Two Satyrs Giving Drink to Bacchus
artworks.description: The image displays three male figures from the waist up. The central figure is seated, with the two other figures leaning in towards him from either side. The central figure has muscular features, large eyes, a wide nose, and pointed ears, with thick foliage as hair. The other figures also have similar facial features and foliage for hair; one has horns curling from the top of his head. All three figures are depicted with the upper half of their bodies exposed, while their lower halves are covered with draped fabrics and goat hair. The central figure holds a bowl in one hand. On the right, one of the side figures holds a cluster of grapes over the central figure. The background shows a tree trunk and branches on the left, and a barrel or large container at their feet, with liquid spilling from the edge next to a rodent on the ground.

artworks.title: Saint Francis Consoled by the Musical Angel
artworks.description: The image depicts a man sitting against a tree, his eyes closed. He has short, curly hair and a beard, wearing a loose garment. He holds a crucifix and beads. Next to him is a human skull on a cloth, a basket, and a dish. Above him, an angel holds a sword, with billowing hair and wings. The background shows a rugged landscape with rocky outcrops and winding rivers or paths, under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Cupid Asleep
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a male child with wings, shown from the neck upwards. The child is lying down with eyes closed and mouth slightly open. He has soft, youthful facial features with chubby cheeks, a small nose, and curly hair. Large wings are visible on each side of him. The background is a plain, solid color with no additional objects present.

artworks.title: Battle of Horsemen and Foot Soldiers
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. Soldiers are depicted fighting with various weapons such as axes and spears. Some are on horseback, while others are on the ground. The composition is dense with tightly packed figures, emphasizing the intensity of the battle. Light and shadow are used to enhance the drama and motion of the scene.

artworks.title: Vulcan at the Forge
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures working at an anvil. The scene depicts a muscular male figure seated on a block, wielding a hammer and chisel as he focuses on his work. A nude female figure stands beside him, engaging with two winged cherubic figures. One cherub stands beside the male figure holding a tool, while the other two interact with the female figure, one holding onto her arm and the other carrying a club-like object. The background features tightly drawn parallel lines, emphasizing the figures in this detailed scene. The intricate detailing of the figures' musculature, hair, and wings highlights the artist's skill in anatomical representation.

artworks.title: Two Peasants Singing
artworks.description: The image depicts two elderly men from the waist up sitting closely together at a table. Both men are leaning toward each other, with their faces close as they examine a document or piece of paper one of them is holding. The man on the left wears a brimless hat and a long-sleeved jacket, partially visible due to the position of his hand holding the paper. The man on the right sports a pointed hat with a brim and a collared long-sleeved overgarment. Their facial features are detailed with lines typical of an older age. The table they sit at holds a few items, including a glass, a bowl with a spoon inside, and some smaller objects. In the background, the wall has a rustic texture with what seems to be a calendar or paper notice posted on it. An overhead beam with rolled-up material or scrolls stored near the ceiling is visible.

artworks.title: Johannes Zurenus (Jan van Zuren)
artworks.artist: Hendrik Goltzius after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of an older man. He is looking directly at the viewer. The man has distinct facial features, a full beard, thinning hair, and a prominent nose. He is wearing an intricate garment with a fur collar and is holding a book. The background is plain with a decorative crest in the upper right corner featuring a shield with a castle-like emblem. Text above the image reads, "IOHANNES ZVRENVS. AETAT. 71. Domini, 88." Additional writing below the image gives a historical or commemorative context.

artworks.title: Old Man Sleeping in an Armchair
artworks.description: The image shows an older man sitting in a wooden armchair. He appears reclined with his eyes closed, hands clasped in front of his chest. He has long hair and a beard, wearing layered robes. His legs are visible with patterned stockings or trousers. The chair has a high back and rounded finials. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Mater Dolorosa Kneeling, Supported by Two Angels
artworks.artist: Willem van der Leeuw after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The image shows three figures depicted from the waist up. The central figure has long hair, looking upward as a hand points a dagger towards their chest. The central figure is surrounded by two winged figures. The figure on the left has short hair, while the figure on the right has medium-length hair. All figures are draped in flowing garments. The central figure wears a robe with voluminous sleeves. The setting includes a cross on the ground with a crown of thorns and a nail. The background is filled with shadows and rays of light emanating from the top of the image.

artworks.title: Saint Anthony
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed half-body portrait of an elderly man with his eyes closed, head turned slightly, and a long beard flowing onto his chest. He is wearing a robe with wide sleeves and a draped hood, with no visible jewelry or items in his hands. The background has a simple crosshatched texture, with faint foliage or sketch lines in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: The Fountain and the Column of Trajan in Rome
artworks.medium: etching with punch engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a grand fountain surrounded by figures, both sculptural and human, in an urban setting. The perspective is direct and level, allowing a full view of the scene. The fountain's sculpture features figures with water streaming down, captured in precise strokes. The backdrop includes an architectural panorama with a tall column. The color palette is primarily sepia. People and buildings are seen around the fountain, with distant mountains visible in the background.
